messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Moi Erkki, I just swapped the SFP on TRN-063 here at OULU-11. The link is up and optics look ok, but all counters are zero and no traffic is passing through.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Moi Veikko. Seen this on the older units. Don't swap the optic again and don't reboot the node.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Just do a shut / no shut on the port. It usually wakes up the ASIC.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Okay, let me try that. I did a shut / no shut on the port now.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Yes, it came back! Traffic is flowing now and counters are going up nicely. Thanks! :)

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Excellent, good to hear. So the TX-250s of that age do it too, good to know for the future.
